title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Tiger Woods’ TGL Return
items.text: Kevin Kisner revealed Tiger Woods plans to play a full TGL schedule next year and could return to competitive golf as early as December with the Hero World Challenge and PNC Championship as key events.

items.headline: Ian Poulter Exits LIV Golf
items.text: Ryder Cup legend Ian Poulter announced he is leaving LIV Golf to spend more time with family and focus on senior golf, marking a significant departure amid LIV’s uncertain future.
